For ClassCastException: if the key is of an inappropriate type, `get` also has the same optional ClassCastException condition; if `get` succeeds, the key is appropriate for the map, so `remove` will not throw ClassCastException; thus this exception is avoided. For UnsupportedOperationException: there is no prior check or operation that would prevent this exception; the code assumes `remove` is supported and calls it unconditionally; therefore this exception is not avoided.
